name: Personal Newspaper
description: Build a personalized newspaper with family planning, sourced reading, comics, drawing lessons, and checked puzzles, delivered as a reviewed PDF with optional email and printing.
author: Ted Tschopp
coverImageAlt: Three navy paper houses nestle in an open blank newspaper beneath a cyan sun and an orange bookmark.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a personalized daily newspaper represented as a carefully folded warm-paper broadsheet sheltering a small collection of miniature household scenes, bringing a household's plans and reading together in one tangible publication.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet slate editorial work surface with a broad uninterrupted warm-paper background and calm architectural depth.
Subject: one open folded broadsheet with completely blank paper surfaces, gently curved into a shallow cradle; within it stand three simple navy paper houses of different sizes, a tiny cyan sun rising behind them, and one restrained orange folded-paper bookmark. The newspaper's layered folds and little neighborhood form a single clear sculptural silhouette. No writing, columns of marks, portraits, or decorative symbols on the paper.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, crisp paper edges, subtly fibrous warm paper, and matte painted forms.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; low three-quarter view; keep the entire newspaper, houses, sun, bookmark, and shadows comfortably inside the central 78%; a continuous quiet border surrounds the complete scene; no essential detail in the outer 8%; readable at a small gallery-card size.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with gentle morning light and restrained cyan backlighting.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Constraints: no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, glyphs, logos, trademarks, watermark, labels, grids, or interface elements; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, Microsoft branding, or Microsoft Fluent gradients; no real people or private household details.
